## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Evidence / behavior

Explain how the change affects extraction, analysis, recommendations, reporting, or documentation.

## Testing

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] No live-site dependency was added to deterministic tests without a strong reason

## Safety and methodology

- [ ] URL/network changes follow `SECURITY.md`
- [ ] Recommendations expose evidence rather than only an opaque score
- [ ] New claims or labels are documented and appropriately limited
- [ ] No secrets or confidential datasets are included
